result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): B names the real alternatives in more detail, says plainly that there is no payroll or accounting integration, and ends on one clear primary message. A invents more claims: payroll and accounting on the roadmap, two-tap tasks, shallow menus, weekly customer calls and driver route views. It also recasts the CSV-only export as a data-ownership selling point. Neither answer mentions the 9-shop pilot or flags the missing proof as a gap, and both add unsupported details such as restaurant customers. B's extras include per-seat POS pricing and automatic pickup reminders. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): Both answers name the real alternatives and leave out the 9-shop pilot and the missing proof entirely. B makes up more: two-tap tasks, weekly customer calls, a driver app that shows what's packed and where to drop it, and a roadmap that includes payroll, which the facts don't support. A has a clearer primary message ('built by laundry operators for laundry operators') and is honest about having no payroll or accounting integration, though it runs a bit long and adds a few unsupported details such as retail POS charging by the seat.
